HARBOR LABS SAMPLE RECORD. Fictional: every name, date and number is invented.
Page 1 of 1
Minute book index, kept by Nina Note, Secretary, as of June 30, 2011
1. June 3, 2011: action of the incorporator and first written consent of the board.
2. June 9, 2011: board meeting adopting the bylaws.
3. June 15, 2011: board consent adopting the 2011 Equity Incentive Plan.
4. June 20, 2011: board and stockholder consent approving the Series Seed financing.
5. June 21, 2011: stockholder consent to the restated certificate of incorporation.
The minute book is kept in the company office at 100 Example Street, with a scanned
copy in the 12-Formation folder.
